frozen_reference: R4 exact historical D2, not retrained

data.preprocessing: exact original patient_z then FIT-only SimpleImputer and StandardScaler; bitwise archived bank; no feature re-extraction; NPZ y never loaded

architecture.source: rank-r original UV and four scalar biases; R0 bias only; unknown source zero correction
architecture.initialization: seed42+1009*fold; shared state identical; dedicated CPU generator42+7000+training_seed for V Normal(0,.01); u,b zero; no warmstart
architecture.rank_audit: float64 U@V; SVD numerical rank tolerance96*eps(float64)*largest singular value; zero matrix rank0; factor weights not identifiable

training.loss: NEZ-positive mean BCE with FIT EZcount/NEZcount pos_weight; one update per FIT patient
training.order: original sorted groups, default_rng(seed+epoch).permutation; reseed after model construction
training.regularizer: mean(V^2)+mean_g[w_g*(mean(u_g^2)+b_g^2)], w_g=(N_FIT/4)/max(n_FIT,g,1); R0 removes nonexistent V/u terms only; rank-dependent mean-square spaces not compensated
training.device: cuda float32, no AMP/TF32; original audited runtime312
training.resume: exact complete epoch model/Adam/CPU+CUDA RNG/history; SHA bindings; no outcome-based repetition

selection.R4: archived selected checkpoint/threshold, exact frozen scores after fresh forward drift<2e-6

evaluation.unit: unique patient-ID clusters preserving repeated development appearances, appearance-equal point metrics
evaluation.positive_patient_definition: unique-ID mean contrast across all its appearances >0, not counting repeated appearances separately

interventions.classification: same checkpoint and selected numeric threshold, NEZ float32 sigmoid
interventions.ranking: bias is source-constant within patient; verify float64 component-order translation; reuse full-model frozen ranking for bias-off to prevent numerical tie artifacts; direction-off ranks by shared base; quantify direction-induced pair reversals

gate.severe_source_collapse: any source patient-equal Macro-F1 drop >0.050 vs frozen R4 blocks supported terminal; no posthoc explanation waiver

terminal_priority: SOURCE_RANK_TARGET_0P70_REACHED if any qualifying compressed candidate reaches.700, disclose R2 gate separately
RANK2_COMPRESSION_GAIN_SUPPORTED if full R2 gate passes
RANK1_COMPRESSION_GAIN_SUPPORTED if R1 magnitude/fold/EZF1/AP/source/finite gates pass; exploratory secondary candidate
SOURCE_BIAS_ONLY_SUFFICIENT if R0 same gates pass; exploratory secondary candidate
RANK4_REMAINS_BEST if all new Macro-F1 point estimates <=R4
public: code, protocol/input/checkpoint hashes, non-identifying aggregate metrics/mechanism audits only
